rules: Diary, C5c-09, abductive (written before the read). For each of the 158 rooms carrying both P08 and P07, the first P07 concept read whole (c5c9_a05_read.txt): L, it names a border, truce, deal, policy or agreement (the line); T, sparing, restraint, a refusal or an apology with none named (tacit); O, not the room sparing a neighbour (an appeal by the damaged party, an accusation, an attack, a build proposal, a broken treaty). Coded by the analyst alone at C5c-09.

notes.L: 4chan (Rule 8), Fez (a limit on its own space), PinkVomitMonster ('They agreed to go under Our Beast'), TeamYellowPlace ('We shall let the Blue line exist'), animalcrossing ('your agreement'), bisexual (the break left after talks), eagles (room in return for help), germany (Operation EU Love), homestuck ('kept our stuff in borders'), italy (groups that 'respected our creative space'), leafs (an alliance), ockytop ('clearly defined spaces'), oneshot ('our allies'), purplecorner (PurplePixels' declared mercy), stlouis ('a standing order'), terraria (a border that connects), wine ('let us keep this space')
notes.T: most state a norm of the room with no agreement: 'Don't ruin other people work' [czech/c0062]; 'Nah don't mess with other people's shit.' [overwatch/c0557]; 'We want to avoid consuming another community's project' [starcraft/c0062]; apologies and refusals of a raid also fall here
notes.O: appeals by the damaged party ('Can you guys stop it? Leave our stuff alone.' [newzealand/c0165]), accusations, attack or build calls, and one treaty broken ('we have to break the treaty now' [xcom/c0113])
